authority.source: CPython sqlite3 binding to real SQLite native library
authority.runtime: python 3.12 ubuntu-24.04 GitHub runner; local Python preflight separately

objective: From identical passive observations of a native SQLite schema, construct a state-separating rollback-only probe and discover the minimum permissible configuration change that prevents invalid child references while preserving valid inserts. Compile conditional method; repeat on fresh differently named schemas.

worlds.start: fresh native :memory: database, empty tables, identical SQL schema and tables
worlds.goal: Rejected invalid child reference as sqlite3.IntegrityError; valid parent/child inserts must succeed; no mutation by probes; if already safe, no configuration modification

observations: construct INSERT into a child referencing a provably absent parent key
execute within SAVEPOINT and always ROLLBACK TO plus RELEASE
primitive_language.discover_names_via: PRAGMA pragma_list on a disposable native connection; do not supply winning name to candidate generator
primitive_language.construction_limit: one generated violating INSERT with bound parameters; single writable PRAGMA; no synthesis of SQL grammar
primitive_language.candidate_validation: native oracle on two fresh instances and independent focused check; privilege restricted to disposable in-memory DB

development_schema.child: lineitem(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, inventory_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory(id), memo TEXT NOT NULL)

protected_schema_distribution.seed_source: sha256(GITHUB_SHA || github.run_id || declared fixed tag); generated after frozen source exists
protected_schema_distribution.limits: one FK referencing single parent primary key, empty tables

required_gates: two hidden modes identical under declared passive observations
generated probe separates modes with rollback and no persistent mutation
discover candidate from engine-listed options without hardcoded winning name in learner
independent SQLite-native semantics for invalid and valid inserts, both modes
compilation restores capability on different-name held-out schemas and separate process
ablation of capability prevents repair on an unsafe instance while unaffected safe instance stays safe
forged/stale evidence denied; no external effects
full candidate counts and baseline parity/cost in machine-readable artifact
comparators: fully informed native status-query baseline (may outperform)
fully informed native exhaustive control enumeration with equivalent candidates
claim_boundaries: not autonomous invention of SQL or hardware controls
not a blind external new repository
not proof of universal world modeling
not stronger than LLM without actual LLM baseline
no claim of economic gain on tie
pass_fail: PASS_NATIVE_BOUNDED only for all required gates; full-info baseline TIE or win => comparative superiority UNKNOWN/REJECTED for this test; any failed required gate is explicit RED
side_effects: No external database, no GitHub production app, no upstream edits, only this isolated owned research branch and Actions.
